task_title: AUG-136: the repo ships a real authored spec corpus — specs/ holds spec-graph.xml, spec-verbs.xml and verification.xml, gate-validated on every run, with a generated docs view the tests keep byte-identical (fix 22bc7aa, graded at the current merged head)
task_criteria: Board AC1 (first half): the repo ships a real authored spec corpus -- at least three .xml documents live under specs/ (not under tests/) and they validate through the shipped CLI. FAILIF: `auger spec validate specs` exits non-zero, or it reports fewer than 3 documents or fewer than 12 blocks. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python auger.py spec validate specs; echo validate_rc=$? -- expect 'spec: 3 document(s), 12 block(s), 7 reference(s) ok' and validate_rc=0.

Board AC1 (second half): the corpus names REAL tests in this repository rather than fixture names -- every type="test" citation resolves against the consuming repository, selector included. FAILIF: `spec check specs` exits non-zero, or specs/*.xml carry fewer than 7 type="test" citations. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python auger.py spec check specs; echo check_rc=$?; grep -ohc 'type="test"' specs/*.xml -- expect check_rc=0 with a valid status and 7 citations in total (2 in spec-graph.xml, 2 in spec-verbs.xml, 3 in verification.xml), every cited path git-tracked with a selector the named file defines.

Board AC2: CI validates the corpus on every run, so an empty or broken corpus fails the build instead of passing silently. FAILIF: tests/gate.sh has no `auger.py spec validate specs` arm, no `spec check specs` arm, or no empty-corpus guard. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && grep -c 'auger.py spec validate specs' tests/gate.sh; grep -c 'auger.py spec check specs' tests/gate.sh; grep -c 'spec corpus MISSING' tests/gate.sh -- expect 1, 1, 1.

Board AC3: the authored corpus is the source for a generated view committed to docs/, regenerating the view from the XML reproduces the committed bytes, and a gate-named test enforces that parity so the view cannot drift. FAILIF: `scripts/gen_spec_view.py --check` exits non-zero, either committed view is missing, or tests/test_spec_corpus_view.py is absent from the gate's pytest arm. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python scripts/gen_spec_view.py --check; echo view_rc=$?; grep -c 'tests/test_spec_corpus_view.py' tests/gate.sh -- expect view_rc=0 naming docs/SPEC-CORPUS-VIEW.md and docs/SPEC-CORPUS-VIEW.html as matching the corpus, and count 1.

The parity suite is green and the implementation is in the judged tree: the derived-not-copied mutation arm actually runs, and the row's landed fix commit is an ancestor of HEAD. FAILIF: any test in tests/test_spec_corpus_view.py fails, the suite collects fewer than 11 tests, or the ancestry check exits non-zero. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_spec_corpus_view.py; git merge-base --is-ancestor 22bc7aa687eeced20b1ca79678fb4fafb6b37109 HEAD; echo ancestor_rc=$? -- expect '11 passed' and ancestor_rc=0.

PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_spec_corpus_view.py; git merge-base --is-ancestor 22bc7aa687eeced20b1ca79678fb4fafb6b37109 HEAD; echo ancestor_rc=$? -- expect '11 passed' and ancestor_rc=0.
items.detail: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_spec_corpus_view.py` -> `collected 11 items ... 11 passed in 0.22s` (exit 0). `git merge-base --is-ancestor 22bc7aa687eeced20b1ca79678fb4fafb6b37109 HEAD` -> `ancestor_rc=0`. The corpus/view commits are also ancestors: 4880701 (author corpus), 6b0d190 (self-verifying + gate), 3f64a4e (generated view), 4ffad26 (rollback) all report ancestor=yes. Related suites (test_spec_render, test_spec_validators_agree, test_xsd_conformance, test_spec_repository_root, test_verification_graph, test_xml_specs) -> `124 passed in 11.93s`.

items.criterion: The gate's corpus arm is a live shell arm (not a comment) and its empty-corpus branch exits non-zero, so a missing corpus fails the build.
items.detail: tests/gate.sh:313-320: the `if` tests for the XSD and for any `*.xml` under specs/; the `then` branch runs both verbs with `|| exit 1` (315-316); the `else` branch prints `spec corpus MISSING: specs/ holds no authored *.xml — this arm would pass vacuously` to stderr (318) and executes `exit 1` (319). No `skip_required_arm` escape hatch on this arm.

items.criterion: The committed views are git-tracked and the generator's --check compares against the committed bytes (not a self-render), so drift is actually detectable.
items.detail: `git ls-files` lists docs/SPEC-CORPUS-VIEW.md and docs/SPEC-CORPUS-VIEW.html. scripts/gen_spec_view.py:88-105: `--check` reads the committed file (`committed = path.read_text(...) if path.is_file() else ""`) and compares it to a fresh `build_view`, printing `... has drifted from the corpus — regenerate: ...` and returning 1 on mismatch; the live run returned 0 with both 'matches the corpus' lines. tests/test_spec_corpus_view.py::test_the_generator_check_mode_reports_drift additionally proves rc 1 on a mutated corpus.

items.criterion: The parity test file is itself git-tracked and its mutation arm is non-vacuous (mutating the corpus changes the rendered view).
items.detail: tests/test_spec_corpus_view.py is git-tracked. test_mutating_the_corpus_mutates_the_view copies specs/ to tmp, rewrites one block's prose and one block's status via _mutate(), and asserts `after != before`, that the mutated sentence appears in the new render and not the old, and that `· superseded ·` appears — so the view is derived, not copied. It ran green inside the 11-passed run.

items.criterion: The corpus's own claims about the CLI hold: `spec bundle` resolves the cited path/selector/runner from the authored corpus.
items.detail: `.venv/bin/python auger.py spec bundle specs SPEC-OBL-CONSUMER` -> `{"count":2,"id":"SPEC-OBL-CONSUMER","status":"ok","verifications":[{"id":"SPEC-OBL-CONSUMER-V1","path":"tests/test_spec_repository_root.py","runner":["/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin/python","-m","pytest"],"selector":"test_a_consumer_repository_validates_and_bundles_its_own_test","type":"test"}, {"id":"SPEC-OBL-CONSUMER-V2", ... "selector":"test_no_root_and_no_flag_refuses_instead_of_using_augers_tree" ...}]}` — the authored citations resolve to real tracked tests with the registered runner.

items.criterion: The corpus documents live under specs/ (not tests/) and are git-tracked, so they ship with the repo.
items.detail: `git ls-files specs/` -> specs/schema/auger-spec-1.0.xsd, specs/spec-graph.xml, specs/spec-verbs.xml, specs/verification.xml. No authored corpus document is tracked under tests/ (tests/ holds only fixtures used by the suites).
